title: Smoked Sweet and Pear Skewers
description: A gluten-free and flavorful skewer recipe that combines the sweetness of pear and the smokiness of Argentinean-style grilled meats.

ingredients.name: Argentinian Smoked Sausage
ingredients.notes: you can substitute with chorizo or morcilla

ingredients.name: Korean BBQ Sauce
ingredients.notes: use a gluten-free version if needed

instructions: Soak wooden skewers in water for 30 minutes.
Thread pear, sausage, pepper, onion, and garlic onto skewers, leaving a little space between each piece.
Brush skewers with olive oil and season with salt.
Grill skewers for 8-10 minutes per side, or until sausage is cooked through and vegetables are tender.
Brush with Korean BBQ sauce during the last 2 minutes of grilling.
Serve hot, garnished with additional pear slices if desired.
